aggregation: seeds averaged within a partition; mean and std over partitions

era_check.era_line_rule: >= 75% of one era and <= 25% of the other
era_check.note: p-values are not reliable: neighbouring bands are correlated and several models are tested without correction

baseline.metric: drop in val macro F1 when a band is shuffled across segments

cnn.metric: drop in the probability of the true class when a band is set to the train mean (occlusion); saliency |d logit / d input| per band and class

cnn_aug.metric: drop in the probability of the true class when a band is set to the train mean (occlusion); saliency |d logit / d input| per band and class

hybrid.metric: drop in the probability of the true class when a band is set to the train mean (occlusion); saliency |d logit / d input| per band and class

hybrid_aug.metric: drop in the probability of the true class when a band is set to the train mean (occlusion); saliency |d logit / d input| per band and class

transformer.metric: drop in the probability of the true class when a band is set to the train mean (occlusion); saliency |d logit / d input| per band and class

transformer_aug.metric: drop in the probability of the true class when a band is set to the train mean (occlusion); saliency |d logit / d input| per band and class

split: val of every partition (test not used); the era check describes the mean spectra of every vessel, without any model
